title: Intuitive controls and interface
summary: Feedback on the G60 interface and controls centers on how intuitive the screen layout, user interface, and physical controls feel in everyday use.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the interface, screen, and controls feel intuitive, simple, and easier to use than older or familiar alternatives.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the interface or certain controls, including cruise control, do not feel intuitive and can be harder to understand than expected.

mixed.summary: The mixed review pairs an overall acceptable impression with criticism that some screen functions are not very intuitive to access.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined review suggests the user interface should be more straightforward, but the sentiment label does not clearly resolve whether this is praise or criticism in context.

limitations: The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 owners.
One positive-labeled fragment appears textually negative, so the evidence includes at least one label-text mismatch.
Examples focus broadly on interface intuitiveness but mix screen layout, general UI, and specific controls, limiting finer-grained conclusions.
